Route 1-1-description: Note: He always has a Litten.

Bug Bite.name: Bug Bite
Bug Bite.description: Deals damage. Then, drains 2 energy from the opponent's most full energy type and gives it to the user.
Bug Bite.shortDescription: Deals some damage and drains energy.

Ember.name: Ember
Ember.description: Deals damage. There's a 10% chance for this move to inflict Burn on 3 random tiles. At the start of each turn, the opponent takes damage for each Burned tile on the board.

Growl.name: Growl
Growl.description: Lowers the opponent's attack stat by 1 stage.

Leafage.name: Leafage
Leafage.description: Deals damage. 3 random tiles are transformed into Grass tiles.
Leafage.shortDescription: Damages and turns tiles into Grass tiles.

Leer.name: Leer
Leer.description: Lowers the opponent's defense stat by 1 stage.

Payback.name: Payback
Payback.description: Deals damage. If the user's speed stat is less than the speed stat of their opponent, this move's power increases by 50.

Peck.name: Peck
Peck.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects.

Pound.name: Pound
Pound.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects.

String Shot.name: String Shot
String Shot.description: Lowers the opponent's speed stat by 2 stages.

Struggle.name: Struggle
Struggle.description: An attack of desperation only useful when there are no available moves. It also hurts its user a little, before ending the current turn.
Struggle.shortDescription: Reshuffle board. Does recoil damage. Ends the turn.

Supersonic.name: Supersonic
Supersonic.description: Applies Confused. After a Confused Pokemon uses a move, there's a 50% chance for their turn to end.

Swift.name: Swift
Swift.description: Deals damage. This move can be used more than once during a turn.

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects.

Water Gun.name: Water Gun
Water Gun.description: Deals damage. This move's power increases by 2 for every Water tile on the board.

Wrap.name: Wrap
Wrap.description: Gives 2-5 tiles on the board the Wrap status. When an opponent removes those tiles, this move deals them damage.

Confused.name: Confused
Confused.description: After a Confused Pokemon uses a move, there's a 50% chance for their turn to end.
